dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, that's a really long letter. Seems like Zhiqiong left it here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, where's she gone!? Let's go tell Jinwu what happened first.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, relax. What did you find? Does it have anything to do with Zhiqiong's whereabouts?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's a letter she left behind. She says she's gone deeper into The Chasm.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Thank you. Let me see what she's written real quick.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: This girl... I've never really considered issues this big, so I can't really criticize her life choices. But perhaps...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Perhaps I didn't acknowledge her discoveries in time, or give her as much respect or understanding as I should've.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: It would've been immeasurably more difficult to complete our exploration without her maps... But I only showed concern for her health instead of focusing on her hard work and what she'd done so much to achieve...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Agh, how did I not realize how her work was always different from that of us miners...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She just doesn't want to be forgotten.

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Well, don't we all, as people who aren't favored by the gods...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: Don't we all... But has anyone been as obsessed as her?

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: And yet, when I think about the moment when I gave up any thoughts of becoming great... when I realize that I've gotten to used to living day to ordinary day...

dialogues.speaker: Jinwu
dialogues.text: I feel like I just don't have the right to judge Zhiqiong...
